**Quadragesimo Anno** was written by **Pope Pius XI**.  
He died in the **Vatican City** (Rome) on 10 February 1939.

The **Vatican City** became a sovereign country when the **Lateran Treaty** was signed with Italy:

| Event | Date |
|-------|------|
| Signing of the Lateran Treaty (the text that established Vatican City as a sovereign state) | 11 February 1929 |
| Treaty entered into force, granting Vatican City full independent status | **7 June 1929** |

So, the place where the author of *Quadragesimo Anno* died—**Vatican City—achieved its own country status on 7 June 1929** (following the 11 February 1929 signing).
